findings.title: Qualify miss-buffer and transitive constructor-RNG claims
evidence: The final DCS sentence says a genuine miss must return the caller initial point/normal words unchanged. The closed original TREE contract expressly includes misses that partly overwrite those buffers. No-hit does not universally imply no write; the service must return the actual final original-contract words.

The statement that the forest constructor itself draws nothing because it contains no rand is lexical, not transitive. construct_3d_object_by_name (3dobjid.c783..801) calls construct_3d_object; 3dobjdb.c2950 calls skin_random, which draws at 3dobjid.c950/954 when skin.animation>=0. Current text supplies no supported actual forest skin fact excluding this branch. This review does not assert that a new retail constructor actually drew.
findings.minimum_correction: State actual final miss-word behavior, including partial overwrites. Keep constructor RNG conditional/unproved until the effective forest skin metadata and call/seed observations show the branch; include that condition in the already required loader-removal disposition. No new capture is needed merely to correct these two prose claims, and no current loader/draw deletion or dummy padding is authorized by this report.
